name: FR I Anime-Sama
description: Stream French anime (VOSTFR / VF) from Anime-Sama. Search returns one entry per season so episode numbers line up; playback resolves vidmoly (HLS) or sibnet (MP4). No account needed. If anime-sama.to stops working, set a new base URL in the settings.
author: dynnx

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.label: Anime-Sama base URL (change only if anime-sama.to is down or moved, e.g. a new domain)
